name: bro-plus
description: Bro_plus — one screen-share-invisible Chromium browser that fuses Browse + a Postman-class API client + a Burp-class intercepting proxy, as build-selectable plugins.
author: Mahajan
comment:future-deps: Added in their ROADMAP phase (all install without a C compiler EXCEPT better-sqlite3, which needs node-gyp/MSVC — use the JSONL history fallback if unavailable): mockttp (proxy MITM), @iarna/toml (collections), @ghostery/adblocker-electron (adblock), better-sqlite3 (proxy history).
